name: outbound-reply-guard
label: Outbound reply guard
description: Backstops the Gmail confirm surface at the platform layer, for EVERY caller. The send_outcome tool only ever runs from the operator-confirmed Send reply action, but the Gmail send_message tool exists whenever the connection is loaded, and a future tool (or the chat agent) could call it. This preToolUse hook fires on any send_message with two rules: a run triggered by an automation or webhook is blocked outright (no human present, nobody to confirm), and otherwise the recipient is resolved to a submission via broker_email and the send is blocked when that submission has no saved risk finding (i.e. it was never triaged). So 'no reply before a decision, and no reply nobody confirmed' is true platform-wide, not just inside one handler. Capability gate (store:read) + verified caller are platform-supplied, while the policy (the rule) is the author's, owned here.
